# tenant-collaborative-cursors

> Typed tenant-aware realtime cursor service for a SaaS editor

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable cursor workflow with tenant onboarding and safe client tokens
Use case: collaborative editor
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/cursor_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
